name: The Rise
description: Elevate your laptop to eye level with The Rise. Precision-carved from premium hardwood, this stand provides ergonomic comfort and superior airflow for your machine. The angled design reduces neck strain during long work sessions while adding warmth and character to your desk setup.

name: The View
description: Keep your phone at the perfect angle with The View. Whether you're on a video call, following a recipe, or just keeping an eye on notifications, this handcrafted wooden holder keeps your device secure in both portrait and landscape orientation.

name: The Grip
description: Display your controller or joystick in style with The Grip. Designed to cradle any major controller brand, this stand doubles as a showcase piece when you're not gaming. Felt-lined contact points protect your gear from scratches.

name: The Shift
description: Type in comfort with The Shift. This keyboard riser provides the ideal ergonomic angle for extended typing sessions, reducing wrist fatigue. Fits full-size and tenkeyless keyboards. Rubber grip feet keep everything stable.

name: The Base
description: Anchor your workspace with The Base. This premium desk mat features a real wood veneer surface with cork backing for a non-slip grip. Provides a smooth, warm surface for your mouse and keyboard while protecting your desk from scratches.

name: The Arch - Headphone Stand
description: Handcrafted solid hardwood headphone stand featuring a precision-sculpted arc that preserves your headband shape. Weighted solid wood base with non-slip pads keeps your headphones elevated in style.

name: Creator Bundle
description: The essential creator setup. Includes The Rise (Laptop Stand), The View (Phone Holder), and The Grip (Controller Holder). Save 15% compared to buying individually. All pieces are crafted from matching wood grain for a cohesive look.

name: Studio Bundle
description: The complete desk transformation. Includes all five Oxel products: The Rise, The View, The Grip, The Shift, and The Base. Save 15% and get a perfectly matched wooden desk setup that looks incredible on camera and in person.
